scope.description: 14 real archive cases and 13 synthetic direct/interactive cases; 27 finite API availability expectations. All unlisted combinations remain unknown.

rules.claim: Resolve each owner before inheriting from its base; canonical child art outranks named base art.
Within each owner, asset-bearing exact signed state ID wins before named roles, regardless author label/key. Owner/base order remains an explicit modern policy.
When an owner has no asset-bearing exact negative state ID, named roles precede positive-ID aliases; actual signed ID or null remains unchanged.
Only positive-ID compatibility aliases may be rejected by role labels/keys; author labels never reject the exact negative source-dispatch ID.
Missing active face may use pressed; missing inactive face may use active. Does not certify historical face-state fallback.
An explicitly empty finite/cyclic source graph yields null from the direct compositor; caller owns fallback.
interactiveButton on empty art returns a labelled native button with keyboard action and disabled semantics.
Plain button may reserve ring layout metadata but must not paint a default ring.
Canonical bevel lookup respects child ownership before base inheritance.
For these exact API states, request active -10239, pressed -10238, inactive -10240. Source resource existence is separate from compatibility resolution.
For these exact normal-size clear bevel API states, request active -10166, pressed -10165, inactive -10167; no broader state/size combinations inferred.
